Name: Harosheth-hagoyim
ModernLocation: Disputed; in the vicinity of the Jezreel Valley, proposed sites include Tel Regev and Ahwat
Description: The base of Sisera, captain of Jabin's army, from which his nine hundred chariots of iron set out against Israel, and to which his defeated host fled before Deborah and Barak.
BiblicalSignificance: Harosheth-hagoyim is where Canaan's iron power gathered, and where it broke; the victory song remembers it as the place oppression came from and never returned to.
RelatedPeople: Deborah; Barak; Sisera; Jabin, King of Canaan
